title: Bacon Chili without Beans
description: Mom's adapted recipe for beef and bacon chili without beans may start out looking chunky, but it gets nice and juicy as it simmers in the slow cooker.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package thick-cut bacon, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2 (14.5 ounce) cans petite diced tomatoes, drained
0.25 cup hot sauce (such as Frank's® RedHot®)

steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain and discard grease. Transfer beef to a slow cooker.
Cook bacon in the same skillet, stirring occasionally, until evenly browned, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain and discard grease. Transfer bacon to the slow cooker; stir.

Add diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, onions, bell pepper, beef stock, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic to the slow cooker; stir until well combined. Stir in chili powder, cayenne pepper, oregano, salt, cumin, basil, paprika, and black pepper until thoroughly mixed.
Cover the slow cooker; cook on Low for 5 hours. Stir; continue to cook 2 to 3 hours more.
